panels.title: Consommation Heures Pleines
panels.description: Heures creuses Tempo : 22h-6h. Calcul à partir des demi-heures Enedis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)
SELECT SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_hc) AS "Heures Pleines" FROM x

panels.title: Coût Heures Pleines (Tempo)
panels.description: Énergie seule, au tarif EDF Tempo en vigueur à chaque date et selon la couleur du jour.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), p AS (
  SELECT x.*, t.color, o.subscription_price AS abo,
    CASE t.color
      WHEN 'BLUE'  THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END
      WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
      WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
    END AS prix
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'TEMPO' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND ep.name ILIKE '%EDF%'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from <= x.ts) DESC, abs(extract(epoch FROM eo.valid_from - x.ts))
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
SELECT SUM(kwh * prix) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_hc) AS "Coût" FROM p

panels.title: Classe énergétique (12 derniers mois)
panels.description: kWh/m²/an sur les 365 derniers jours, rapportés à la surface saisie dans la variable « Surface de la maison ». Indicatif : énergie finale électrique seulement, pas le calcul officiel du DPE.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(c.value) / 1000.0 / $surface_maison AS "kWh/m²/an" FROM consumption_data c
WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date > current_date - 365

WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,

)
SELECT SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_hc) AS "HP", SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_hc) AS "HC" FROM x

panels.title: Simulation : $offre_base
panels.description: Coût de l'énergie si la même consommation avait été facturée avec l'offre Base choisie en haut du dashboard. Hors abonnement.

targets.rawSql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT c.date, c.value / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), b AS (
  SELECT j.*, o.base_price AS prix, o.subscription_price AS abo FROM j
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'BASE' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva
      AND ep.name || ' - ' || eo.name = '$offre_base'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from::date <= j.date) DESC, abs(eo.valid_from::date - j.date)
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
SELECT SUM(kwh * prix) AS "Coût" FROM b

panels.title: Tempo vs $offre_base
panels.description: Écart de coût total (énergie + abonnement au prorata) entre ton Tempo réel et l'offre Base choisie. Négatif (vert) : Tempo est moins cher.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), p AS (
  SELECT x.*, t.color, o.subscription_price AS abo,
    CASE t.color
      WHEN 'BLUE'  THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END
      WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
      WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
    END AS prix
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'TEMPO' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND ep.name ILIKE '%EDF%'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from <= x.ts) DESC, abs(extract(epoch FROM eo.valid_from - x.ts))
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
, tt AS (SELECT SUM(kwh * prix) + count(*) / 48.0 * MAX(abo) * 12 / 365 AS v FROM p)
, j AS (
  SELECT c.date, c.value / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), b AS (
  SELECT j.*, o.base_price AS prix, o.subscription_price AS abo FROM j
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'BASE' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva
      AND ep.name || ' - ' || eo.name = '$offre_base'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from::date <= j.date) DESC, abs(eo.valid_from::date - j.date)
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
), bb AS (SELECT SUM(kwh * prix) + count(*) * MAX(abo) * 12 / 365 AS v FROM b)
SELECT (tt.v - bb.v) / NULLIF(bb.v, 0) AS "Tempo vs Base" FROM tt, bb

panels.title: Évolution vs N-1
panels.description: Consommation de l'année en cours comparée à la même période de l'année précédente (du 1er janvier à la dernière date disponible).

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT max(c.date) AS m FROM consumption_data c WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl'
), s AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.date BETWEEN date_trunc('year', b.m)::date AND b.m) AS n,
    SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.date BETWEEN (date_trunc('year', b.m) - interval '1 year')::date AND (b.m - interval '1 year')::date) AS n1
  FROM consumption_data c, b
  WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl'
)
SELECT (n - n1)::float / NULLIF(n1, 0) AS "Évolution" FROM s

panels.title: Évolution vs N-2
panels.description: Consommation de l'année N-1 complète comparée à l'année N-2 complète.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 1) - SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 2))::float
  / NULLIF(SUM(c.value) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 2), 0) AS "Évolution"
FROM consumption_data c
WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl'

SELECT lpad(m::text, 2, '0') || ' ' || (ARRAY['Janvier','Février','Mars','Avril','Mai','Juin','Juillet','Août','Septembre','Octobre','Novembre','Décembre'])[m] AS "Mois", SUM(v) / 1000.0 AS "Consommation"

    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN is_hc THEN w END AS "HC" FROM x ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN NOT is_hc THEN w END AS "HP" FROM x ORDER BY 1
